tips: Ask for a rental contract or agreement and sign it duly.
Check the place's address. Even if not possible in person, do a video call to check so that you don't fall for a scam.

transport.description: Madrid has one of Europe's best metro networks. Campuses in Móstoles and Fuenlabrada are served by Cercanías commuter trains from Atocha station.
options: EMT city buses — same Metrobús card valid
Cercanías (commuter train) — Zones A–B for campus
Renfe long-distance trains — for weekend travel around Spain
Lime/Bolt scooters — available in central Madrid
tips: Get an Abono Joven (under 26): unlimited Metro+Bus+Cercanías for €20/month.
Top up your transport card at any metro station machine.
Download the METRO MADRID and CERCANÍAS apps for real-time maps.
Taxi apps: Cabify and FREE NOW are safer than street taxis.

residencePermit.name: TIE — Tarjeta de Identidad de Extranjero
residencePermit.timeline: Apply within 30 days of arrival at the Oficina de Extranjería
documents: Valid passport + photocopy of all pages
University enrollment certificate (Carta de Admisión from URJC)
Empadronamiento (municipal registration certificate from the City Hall / Ayuntamiento)
Proof of financial means (Erasmus grant letter or bank statements)
residencePermit.notes: EU citizens: register at the Registro Central de Extranjeros instead (much simpler). Non-EU students must arrive on a long-stay visa obtained from the Spanish embassy BEFORE travelling.

banking: Open a local Spanish bank such as Santander, BBVA, or another local bank — it will be convenient for many other processes during your mobility. Alternatively, you can open a Wise or Revolut account as a flexible online option.

accommodation.description: Estimated budget: £400–800 per month, including utility bills.

duration: Third Semester — Summer School, University of Tlaxcala

accommodation.description: Accommodation and transport from the airport to your place of stay will be arranged and fully taken care of by the Universidad Autónoma de Tlaxcala (UATx). No further action is required from students — everything will be organised by the university.
Estimated budget: €500–800 per month (prices are higher in Lisbon).
